bio: Walks the Verge with a pot of black and re-bands the cairns the Company's casters lost people mapping.
context_line: Mabbe re-bands the mile-cairns by the only method the Companies trust: where the road last cost them someone.
dialogue_hostile: Keep off the banded stretch. I won't paint you a cairn.
dialogue_warm: Third past the split stone has a fresh band. Wasn't there last month. The thin's walking toward home.
